This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
          • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
          Safety and Security
          • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
          • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
          • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

          • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Convenience
  • Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

The 2021 Mercedes-Benz E-Class E 450 Coupe delivers a sophisticated driving experience by blending grand touring style with advanced technology. This two-door model features a pillarless side glass design that emphasizes its sweeping profile and elegant proportions, standing as a premium hallmark in the luxury segment.
Performance
Under the hood sits a turbocharged inline-six engine paired with an EQ Boost mild-hybrid system. This powerplant produces horsepower and torque routed through a nine-speed automatic transmission. The integration of the electric starter-generator provides immediate responsiveness and seamless stop-start operation, while the ride control suspension balances sharp handling with a smooth ride.
Design
The exterior showcases a refreshed front fascia featuring a redesigned grille, revised LED headlamps, and sleek taillamps. Because there are no B-pillars, lowering the side windows creates an open, airy cabin feel. Inside, the cabin accommodates passengers with leather upholstery, natural wood trims, and heated front sport seats that emphasize both luxury and lateral support.
Technology
The dashboard is anchored by twin digital displays that integrate the instrument cluster and the central multimedia interface. Operating on the MBUX infotainment system, the setup responds to natural voice commands, touchpad gestures, and steering wheel controls. Audiophiles will appreciate the Burmester surround sound system, which features premium speakers alongside smartphone integration and a panoramic sunroof.
Advanced Safety Features
Mercedes-Benz equips this coupe with a comprehensive suite of safety tech designed to prevent collisions. Standard equipment includes Active Brake Assist, Blind Spot Assist, and the predictive Pre-Safe system, which prepares the cabin if an imminent collision is detected. Available upgrades add active distance pacing assistance, lane keeping steering interventions, and a surround-view camera layout.
Convenience and Comfort
Passenger comfort is prioritized with dual-zone automatic climate control, a power steering column, and memory settings for the front seats. Hands-free proximity access allows for keyless entry and push-button ignition, as well as remote trunk opening. While the trunk provides cargo room, the split-folding rear seats offer added versatility for longer items.

This Sierra 2500HD Denali Ultimate comes equipped with an impressive array of features, including:

- 4X4
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Android/Apple CarPlay
- Bed View Camera
- Blind Spot Alert
- Bose Audio
- Heated & Cooled Seats
- Heated Second Row Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Lane Keep Assist
- Navigation
- Power Liftgate
- Power Retractable Boards
- Power Sunroof
- Rear Camera Mirror
- Remote Start
- Trailer Brake Controller
- Trailer Camera Provisions
- Wireless Charging

Elevating the driving experience even further, this Denali Ultimate also features a Heavy Duty Front Spring/Camper Package, a Max Trailering Package, and a striking White Frost Tricoat exterior. With a focus on both form and function, this Sierra 2500HD is the ultimate expression of GMC's commitment to exceptional performance and uncompromising style.

Step inside and you'll be greeted by a cabin that exudes refined luxury. Genuine wood accents, premium leather seating, and a state-of-the-art infotainment system create an environment that is as comfortable as it is sophisticated. The 12-speaker Bose audio system and the stunning 15-inch Head-Up Display further enhance the sensory experience, keeping you connected and entertained throughout your journeys.

Whether you're tackling challenging off-road terrain, towing heavy loads, or simply enjoying the open road, this 2024 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali Ultimate is the perfect companion. Its exceptional capabilities, advanced technology, and premium amenities make it a true standout in the heavy-duty truck segment.

We invite you to experience the unparalleled power, versatility, and luxury of this remarkable vehicle. Visit our showroom today and let us demonstrate how this Sierra 2500HD Denali Ultimate can transform your driving experience.
